title: The Omega Centauri Society — Interactive Calculators for the NGC 5139 IMBH Question
description:
Browser-based suite of interactive calculators for the Omega Centauri (NGC 5139) intermediate-mass black hole debate, Fermi Paradox analysis, and Macro Transcension Hypothesis.

Covers stellar kinematics (M-σ estimator, velocity dispersion), pulsar acceleration constraints (TRAPUM 2026), Gaia DR4 precision forecasting, ADAF/RIAF accretion SEDs (JWST cross-check), gravitational-wave horizon plotting (LISA/ET/CE), Bayesian IMBH evidence aggregation, SETI sensitivity (radio + IR excess), and Kardashev/MTH engineering tools. All 23 ChainGraph-enabled tools emit signed JSON artifacts with execution hash, permalink, and tool citation BibTeX for reproducible research.

Architecture: browser-only, no backend, no PII, no build step. Hash-addressable state for every tool. MCP-exposed at mcp.omegacentauri.me (19 tools, 39 chains). Curated measurement data (measurements.js) is CC0; code is MIT; prose is CC BY 4.0.
